compute_locations: compute block placement origin and offsets for repeated objects based on speaker, memory, and relative direction
compute_location_heuristic: compute a target block position using player look direction, memory objects, steps, and relative direction like BETWEEN or INSIDE
get_repeat_arrangement: get offset positions for arranging repeated objects in a line or circle pattern around a reference object
post_process_loc: post process a location tuple by converting it to block-aligned integer coordinates
review_reference_object_helpers: review the reference object helpers module for location computation, repeat arrangement, and heuristic logic
